newsitem.title: MOROCCO: World Bank lends Morocco $85 mln to expand railway.
newsitem.headline: World Bank lends Morocco $85 mln to expand railway.

text.p: The World Bank granted Morocco's state-owned railway Office National des Chemins de Fer (ONCF) a $85 million loan to expand its domestic network, the Moroccan news agency MAP said on Friday.
The loan, in addition to expanding the network, will finance the purchase of seven locomotives and the refurbishment of existing coaches.
It will be repayable over 20 years with a five-year grace period, the agency added.
The bank's move coincided with the visit of a Moroccan delegation led by Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj to Washington this week, officials said.
